title: अष्टाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 108 · The descent of the Ganga

summary.en: Pleased with Bhagiratha, Shiva receives the Ganga on his head, and she flows in three streams. Bhagiratha leads her to the sea, filling the ocean again and purifying the ashes of Sagara's sons, and Ganga becomes known as his daughter.
summary.kn: ಭಗೀರಥನಿಗೆ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದ ಶಿವನು ಗಂಗೆಯನ್ನು ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಧರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅವಳು ಮೂರು ಧಾರೆಗಳಾಗಿ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಭಗೀರಥನು ಅವಳನ್ನು ಸಮುದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಒಯ್ದು ಸಾಗರವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ತುಂಬಿಸಿ ಸಗರಪುತ್ರರ ಭಸ್ಮವನ್ನು ಪಾವನಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಗಂಗೆ ಅವನ ಮಗಳೆಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಳಾಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: भगीरथ से प्रसन्न शिव गंगा को अपने सिर पर धारण करते हैं, और वे तीन धाराओं में बहती हैं। भगीरथ उन्हें समुद्र तक ले जाते हैं, सागर फिर भरता है और सगर-पुत्रों की राख पवित्र होती है, और गंगा उनकी पुत्री कहलाती हैं।
summary.te: భగీరథునికి ప్రసన్నుడైన శివుడు గంగను తలపై ధరిస్తాడు, ఆమె మూడు ధారలుగా ప్రవహిస్తుంది. భగీరథుడు ఆమెను సముద్రానికి నడిపి సాగరాన్ని మళ్లీ నింపి సగరపుత్రుల భస్మాన్ని పావనం చేస్తాడు; గంగ అతని కుమార్తెగా ప్రసిద్ధి పొందుతుంది.
summary.ta: பகீரதனால் மகிழ்ந்த ஶிவன் கங்கையைத் தலையில் தாங்க, அவள் மூன்று கிளைகளாகப் பாய்கிறாள். பகீரதன் அவளைக் கடலுக்கு வழிநடத்திக் கடலை மீண்டும் நிரப்பி, ஸகரனின் மைந்தர்களின் சாம்பலைத் தூய்மையாக்க, கங்கை அவன் மகள் என்று புகழ்பெறுகிறாள்.
summary.ml: ഭഗീരഥനിൽ പ്രസാദിച്ച ശിവൻ ഗംഗയെ തലയിൽ ഏറ്റുവാങ്ങുന്നു; അവൾ മൂന്നു ധാരകളായി ഒഴുകുന്നു. ഭഗീരഥൻ അവളെ സമുദ്രത്തിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുന്നു; സമുദ്രം വീണ്ടും നിറയുകയും സഗരപുത്രന്മാരുടെ ചാരം ശുദ്ധമാക്കപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു, ഗംഗ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ പുത്രിയെന്ന് അറിയപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.108; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
भगीरथवचः श्रुत्वा प्रियार्थं च दिवौकसाम् ।
एवमस्त्विति राजानं भगवान्प्रत्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Bhagiratha's words, and to please the dwellers in heaven, the blessed lord said to the king, "So be it.

verses.text:
धारयिष्ये महाबाहो गगनात्प्रच्युतां शिवाम् ।
दिव्यां देवनदीं पुण्यां त्वत्कृते नृपसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: "Mighty-armed one, I will hold the auspicious, divine, holy river of the gods as she falls from the sky, for your sake, best of kings."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहो हिमवन्तमुपागमत् ।
संवृतः पार्षदैर्घोरैर्नानाप्रहरणोद्यतैः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, mighty-armed one, he went to the Himalaya, surrounded by fearsome attendants with many weapons raised.

verses.text:
ततः स्थित्वा नरश्रेष्ठं भगीरथमुवाच ह ।
प्रयाचस्व महाबाहो शैलराजसुतां नदीम् ।
पतमानां सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां धारयिष्ये त्रिविष्टपात् ॥

meaning.en: Standing there, he said to Bhagiratha, best of men: "Mighty-armed one, call on the daughter of the king of mountains. I will hold that best of rivers as she falls from heaven."

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजा शर्वेण समुदाहृतम् ।
प्रयतः प्रणतो भूत्वा गङ्गां समनुचिन्तयत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these words spoken by Sharva, the king, controlled and bowing, thought of the Ganga.

verses.text:
ततः पुण्यजला रम्या राज्ञा समनुचिन्तिता ।
ईशानं च स्थितं दृष्ट्वा गगनात्सहसा च्युता ॥

meaning.en: Then the lovely river of holy water, thought of by the king, and seeing Ishana standing there, suddenly fell from the sky.

verses.text:
तां प्रच्युतां ततो दृष्ट्वा देवाः सार्धं महर्षिभिः ।
गन्धर्वोरगरक्षांसि समाजग्मुर्दिदृक्षया ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her fall, the gods with the great sages, gandharvas, serpents and rakshasas gathered, wishing to see.

verses.text:
ततः पपात गगनाद्गङ्गा हिमवतः सुता ।
समुद्भ्रान्तमहावर्ता मीनग्राहसमाकुला ॥

meaning.en: Then Ganga, daughter of the Himalaya, fell from the sky, her great whirlpools wildly turning, thick with fish and sharks.

verses.text:
तां दधार हरो राजन्गङ्गां गगनमेखलाम् ।
ललाटदेशे पतितां मालां मुक्तामयीमिव ॥

meaning.en: King, Hara held that Ganga, girdle of the sky, as she fell on his forehead, like a garland of pearls.

verses.text:
सा बभूव विसर्पन्ती त्रिधा राजन्समुद्रगा ।
फेनपुञ्जाकुलजला हंसानामिव पङ्क्तयः ॥

meaning.en: She spread out, king, in three streams going toward the sea, her waters thick with masses of foam like rows of swans.

verses.text:
क्वचिदाभोगकुटिला प्रस्खलन्ती क्वचित्क्वचित् ।
स्वफेनपटसंवीता मत्तेव प्रमदाव्रजत् ।
क्वचित्सा तोयनिनदैर्नदन्ती नादमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: In places she was bent in curves, in places she stumbled, wrapped in a cloak of her own foam, like a tipsy woman walking; in places she roared with a great sound of water.

verses.text:
एवं प्रकारान्सुबहून्कुर्वन्ती गगनाच्च्युता ।
पृथिवीतलमासाद्य भगीरथमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Making many such forms, she fell from the sky, and on reaching the earth she said to Bhagiratha:

verses.text:
दर्शयस्व महाराज मार्गं केन व्रजाम्यहम् ।
त्वदर्थमवतीर्णास्मि पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: "Great king, show me the way; by which path shall I go? I have come down to earth for your sake, lord of the earth."

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजा प्रातिष्ठत भगीरथः ।
यत्र तानि शरीराणि सागराणां महात्मनाम् ।
पावनार्थं नरश्रेष्ठ पुण्येन सलिलेन ह ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, King Bhagiratha set out to where the bodies of the great Sagaras lay, to purify them with holy water, best of men.

verses.text:
गङ्गाया धारणं कृत्वा हरो लोकनमस्कृतः ।
कैलासं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं जगाम त्रिदशैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Having made Ganga's holding, Hara, honoured by the worlds, went to Mount Kailasa, best of mountains, with the gods.

verses.text:
समुद्रं च समासाद्य गङ्गया सहितो नृपः ।
पूरयामास वेगेन समुद्रं वरुणालयम् ॥

meaning.en: The king reached the sea with the Ganga and filled the sea, Varuna's abode, with her flood.

verses.text:
दुहितृत्वे च नृपतिर्गङ्गां समनुकल्पयत् ।
पितॄणां चोदकं तत्र ददौ पूर्णमनोरथः ॥

meaning.en: The king made Ganga his daughter, and with all his wishes fulfilled, offered water there to his forefathers.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं गङ्गा त्रिपथगा यथा ।
पूरणार्थं समुद्रस्य पृथिवीमवतारिता ॥

meaning.en: I have told you all of how the three-pathed Ganga was brought down to earth to fill the sea,

verses.text:
समुद्रश्च यथा पीतः कारणार्थे महात्मना ।
वातापिश्च यथा नीतः क्षयं स ब्रह्महा प्रभो ।
अगस्त्येन महाराज यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: and how the great Agastya drank the sea for a purpose, and how he destroyed Vatapi, that killer of brahmins, great king, as you asked me.
